originalTitle: Vylor Takes Corteva’s S&P 500 Seat, Twilio Set To Replace Warner Bros. Discovery — Both Stocks Rise After-Hours
summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices added Vylor to the S&P 500 immediately and set Twilio to join before the open on Tuesday, pushing Corteva into the MidCap 400.
content: Vylor replaced Corteva in the S&P 500 on Thursday, the day the separation between the two closed and regular-way trading under the ticker VYLR began on the New York Stock Exchange.Twilio will replace Warner Bros. Discovery in the S&P 500. Corteva replaces Olin in the MidCap 400.Shares of Vylor (VYLR) and Twilio (TWLO) rose in after-hours trading on Thursday after S&P Dow Jones Indices said both will be added to the S&P 500, a change that forces index funds to buy the stocks.Vylor, the seed and genetics business Corteva (CTVA) spun off, was added immediately. Twilio, the cloud software company, joins before the market open on Tuesday. While VYLR edged up 3% after-hours, TWLO gained 1.2%.A Spin-Off Takes Corteva’s SeatVylor replaced Corteva in the S&P 500 on Thursday, the day the separation closed and regular-way trading under the ticker VYLR began on the New York Stock Exchange. Corteva itself leaves the S&P 500 before the open on October 6 and drops into the S&P MidCap 400. S&P said the smaller post-spin company is a better fit for the mid-cap index.Twilio Moves Up From The MidCap 400Twilio will replace Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) in the S&P 500 before the open on October 6, and will leave the MidCap 400 the same morning. Inclusion tends to lift a stock because funds that track the index have to own it. Twilio had been in the MidCap 400 since August 2025.Warner Bros. Discovery is coming out because Paramount Skydance (PSKY) is buying it, in a deal S&P said is expected to close soon, pending final conditions. After the merger, Paramount Skydance will switch its main listing to the New York Stock Exchange.Rest Of The ShuffleThe Corteva move pushes others down the index ladder. Corteva replaces Olin (OLN) in the MidCap 400. Olin then replaces Qorvo in the S&P SmallCap 600. Qorvo (QRVO) is being bought by Skyworks Solutions (SWKS), an S&P 500 company, in a deal also expected to close soon.FormFactor (FORM) moves up from the SmallCap 600 to the MidCap 400, taking the seat Twilio leaves. Workiva (WK) replaces FormFactor in the SmallCap 600. All of those changes take effect before the open on Tuesday.How Did TWLO, CTVA Retail Traders React?On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around TWLO stayed in ‘bullish’ territory over the past 24 hours, while message volume remained ‘high.’Meanwhile, sentiment for CTVA rose from ‘bearish’ to ‘extremely bullish,’ alongside retail chatter increasing from ‘normal’ to ‘extremely high’ levels.Read More: ON, SYNA Climb After-Hours As The $7B Stock Deal Becomes A $5.7B Cash BidFor updates and corrections, email newsroom[at]stocktwits[dot]com.
chineseTitle: Vylor 占据 Corteva 标普 500 指数席位，Twilio 将取代华纳兄弟探索公司 — 两只股票盘后上涨
chineseSummary: 标准普尔道琼斯指数立即将 Vylor 纳入标准普尔 500 指数，并让 Twilio 在周二开盘前加入，将 Corteva 推入中型股 400 指数。
chineseContent: Vylor 于周四取代 Corteva 在标准普尔 500 指数中，当天，两家公司开始在纽约证券交易所进行封闭交易并以股票代码 VYLR 进行常规交易。Twilio 将取代 Warner Bros. Discovery 在标准普尔 500 指数中。Corteva 在 MidCap 400 中取代 Olin。Vylor (VYLR) 和 Twilio (TWLO) 的股价周四在标准普尔道琼斯指数盘后交易中上涨。琼斯指数表示，这两家公司都将被纳入标准普尔 500 指数，这一变化迫使指数基金购买这些股票。 Corteva (CTVA) 剥离出来的种子和基因业务公司 Vylor 立即被纳入其中。云软件公司 Twilio 在周二开盘前加入。 VYLR 盘后小幅上涨 3%，而 TWLO 上涨 1.2%。 周四，分拆完成后，Corteva 的 SeatVylor 取代 Corteva 进入标准普尔 500 指数，当天分拆结束，纽约证券交易所开始以股票代码 VYLR 进行常规交易。 Corteva 本身在 10 月 6 日开盘前退出标准普尔 500 指数，并进入标准普尔中型股 400 指数。标准普尔表示，规模较小的分拆后公司更适合中型股指数。Twilio 从中型股 400 指数上升 Twilio 将在 10 月 6 日开盘前取代华纳兄弟探索公司 (WBD) 在标准普尔 500 指数中的位置，并将于当天早上退出中型股 400 指数。包容性往往会提振股票，因为追踪该指数的基金必须拥有该股票。 Twilio 自 2025 年 8 月起一直被纳入 MidCap 400 指数。华纳兄弟探索公司 (Warner Bros. Discovery) 即将上市，因为派拉蒙 Skydance (PSKY) 正在收购它，标普表示这笔交易预计很快就会完成，但有待最终条件。合并后，派拉蒙 Skydance 将把主要上市地点转移到纽约证券交易所。 洗牌的其余部分 Corteva 的举动将其他公司推向了指数阶梯的下层。 Corteva 取代 MidCap 400 中的 Olin (OLN)。Olin 随后取代 S&P SmallCap 600 中的 Qorvo
